need_help_choosing_desc: Contact our technical advisors to help you choose the right package for your car type.
body_paint_inspection_desc: Precise 50-point inspection of the car body to detect any impacts or previous modifications.
engine_gear_inspection_desc: Testing the performance and efficiency of the engine and transmission using the latest computers.
computer_systems_inspection_desc: Full scan of all sensors, electronic systems and airbags.
car_history_report_desc: Reviewing previous maintenance records and any registered accidents.
report_within_two_hours_desc: We commit to speed without compromising detail quality.
inspection_accuracy_guarantee_desc: We offer you a guarantee on the accuracy of the information in the report.
how_it_works_step_1: Choose the suitable location and time for the inspection via the app.
how_it_works_step_2: A specialized technician heads to the specified location to start the inspection.
how_it_works_step_3: You receive the complete detailed digital report via the app and email.
important_notes_desc: Prices include VAT. The appointment can be cancelled for free up to 24 hours before starting. This package does not include inspection of supercars.

price_may_vary_note: The price may vary based on distance and car type
modern_fleet_desc: We use the latest hydraulic enclosed and open flatbeds.
professional_drivers_desc: An expert team handling all types of sports and luxury cars.
live_tracking_desc: You can track your car's location moment by moment via the app during transport.
superior_protection_desc: Comprehensive insurance on the transported vehicle against all potential damages.
booking_step_1_desc: Enter the pickup and drop-off location details and your car category.
booking_step_2_desc: The final price will show based on distance and expected time.
booking_step_3_desc: The nearest VIP driver will reach your location as fast as possible.
oil_change_desc: Oil change service is one of the most important steps to maintain your car engine's performance and extend its lifespan. Our centers use the finest synthetic oils that ensure smooth movement and protect the engine from deposits and wear.
oil_include_2: Replacing the oil filter with an original part
oil_include_3: Checking all fluid levels in the car
oil_include_5: Resetting the maintenance counter and engine light
oil_warranty_desc: 5,000 km or two months warranty on parts and labor.
technician_quote: "We are keen to use the best technical standards to ensure your engine's safety on every trip."
wash_polish_subtitle: Complete care for your car with the highest quality standards
wash_steam_desc: Advanced steam technology to remove stubborn dirt and protect the car's paint.
wash_interior_desc: Vacuuming and cleaning seats, floors and tight corners with professional precision.
wash_dashboard_desc: Polishing the dashboard and plastic parts with materials that protect from sunlight.
wash_tire_desc: Giving tires a dealership shine with protection of the tire rubber from cracking.
wash_air_desc: Freshening the car cabin with long-lasting refreshing scents and sanitizing it from bad odors.
quality_guarantee_desc: We use the finest German materials specialized in car care to guarantee the best result.
battery_overview_desc: The battery is the beating heart of your car. Our comprehensive "Battery Check" service provides an accurate assessment of the battery and charging system, ensuring you avoid sudden breakdowns and extend the life of your vehicle's electrical components.
voltage_test_desc: Accurate measurement of battery voltage during operation and idle.
battery_note_desc: This process takes about 15-20 minutes. You can wait in our VIP lounge until it's done.

privacy_hero_title: Your data security is our priority
privacy_hero_desc: We are committed to protecting your privacy and to being transparent about how your personal and technical data is used, so we can give your car the best inspection experience.
privacy_collect_intro: We collect the data you give us directly when you use our services, including:
privacy_collect_item1: Personal information: name, phone number and email address.
privacy_collect_item2: Vehicle data: chassis number (VIN), licence plate and technical specifications.
privacy_collect_item3: Location data: to find the nearest approved inspection centres for you.
privacy_collect_outro: This data is used solely to improve the accuracy of inspection reports and to make sure the service reaches you effectively.
privacy_protection_desc: We use the latest global encryption standards (AES-256) to make sure no unauthorised party can reach your inspection reports.
privacy_cookies_desc: We use cookies to analyse site traffic and tailor the content to your technical needs. You can disable them from your browser settings, but this may affect some platform features.
privacy_third_party_desc: We never sell your data. We may share limited data with our approved partners (such as insurance companies or maintenance centres) only at your explicit request or to complete the inspection you asked for.
privacy_updates_desc: We reserve the right to update this policy periodically. You will be notified of any material changes through app notifications or the email address registered with us. Last updated: October 2023.
privacy_footer_question: Have other questions about your privacy?
terms_hero_desc: We are committed to transparency and fairness in delivering car inspection services
terms_intro_p1: Welcome to the Mafhous platform. By using this platform you agree to abide by the terms and conditions set out below. These rules are designed to ensure a safe and professional experience for everyone involved in inspecting and licensing cars.
terms_intro_p2: Please read these terms carefully before booking any appointment. If you do not agree with any part of them, please stop using the platform.
terms_obligation_info_desc: You must provide accurate, correct details about the car, the inspection location and your contact information.
terms_obligation_access_desc: The customer must give the assigned technician easy, safe access to where the car is at the scheduled time.
terms_obligation_payment_desc: You must pay the set inspection fees through the payment channels approved in the app.
terms_obligation_respect_desc: Deal professionally and respectfully with technicians and customer service representatives at all times.
terms_cancellation_free: An order can be cancelled free of charge at least 4 hours before the inspection appointment.
terms_cancellation_fee: If cancelled less than two hours before the appointment, 25% of the inspection value is deducted as an administrative fee.
terms_cancellation_refund: Refunds are returned to the same payment method within 7-14 working days, depending on the issuing bank's policy.
terms_liability_intro: The inspection report reflects the condition of the car at the time of inspection only. It is not a guarantee of its future condition or performance after the technician leaves.
terms_liability_item1: Mafhous is not liable for any sudden mechanical failures that occur after the inspection.
terms_liability_item2: The report is advisory, to help the buyer decide — it is not a recommendation to buy.
terms_liability_item3: The inspection does not include dismantling any part of the engine or complex parts unless a special service is requested.
terms_footer_title: Do you have a legal question?
terms_footer_desc: Our legal team is ready to answer all your questions about the terms of the agreement.
about_tagline: Your trusted partner in inspecting and maintaining your car
about_vision_desc: At Mafhous we aim to bring a technical revolution to car maintenance and periodic inspection. We believe transparency and technology are the key to safer roads and longer-lasting vehicles. Our vision is to become the leading platform and the trusted destination for every car owner looking for a professional, effortless inspection.
about_goal2: Connecting users with the best inspection centres.
about_feature_speed_desc: Book your appointment in under a minute through a simple, easy interface.
about_feature_reports_desc: Get a detailed digital report on your car's condition as soon as the inspection ends.
about_feature_trust_desc: We work only with approved inspection centres that have long experience.
about_feature_alerts_desc: We will always remind you of upcoming inspection dates and car maintenance.
about_footer_note: Join thousands of users who trust us
